notes.coordinates: Rounded pixel corners relative to the original image. Source contains a clipping quirk: y2 above image height assigns image height to y1.
notes.time: Date YYYYMMDD and time HHMMSS are derived from input file modification time in the process local timezone.
notes.files: CSV is appended to <name>.csv; no header. The same invocation also emits normalized YOLO text files.
notes.provenance: Tested with the registry 2023 Zenodo checkpoint using the user-supplied author repository. Repository documentation describes a later study; historical pairing with the 2023 paper remains unconfirmed.
